title: Gautam Budha Wildlife Sanctuary
tagline: Gautam Budha Sanctuary — Dense Dry Deciduous Forests & Hill Wilderness of Magadh

heroImage.alt: Gautam Budha Wildlife Sanctuary - Buddhist pilgrimage sites in India that are of Gurpa in Bihar

overview.short: Gautam Budha Wildlife Sanctuary spans 259 square kilometers across Gaya (Bihar) and Koderma (Jharkhand), preserving rich dry deciduous wildlife corridors.
overview.description: Named in honor of Lord Gautama Buddha, this expansive sanctuary along the lower Chota Nagpur and Magadh plateau protects thriving populations of leopards, chital deer, sambar, wild boars, Indian gazelles (chinkara), and over 150 species of birds.
overview.about: A tranquil forest sanctuary where rugged hills, Buddhist meditation peaks, and rich biodiversity meet along the Bihar-Jharkhand border.

howToReach.roadNote: Accessible via GT Road (NH-19) from Dobhi and SH-70.

topPlaces.name: Gautam Buddha Sanctuary Core Forest
topPlaces.description: Dense mixed Sal and bamboo forest sheltering leopards, chital, sambar deer, and peacocks.

image.alt: Gautam Buddha Sanctuary Core Forest - Nalanda University Ruins

topPlaces.name: Gurpa Hill (Kukkutapadagiri Sacred Peak)
topPlaces.description: Sacred mountain where Mahakashyapa, foremost disciple of Buddha, entered supreme meditation.

image.alt: Gurpa Hill (Kukkutapadagiri Sacred Peak) in Gautam Budha Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Dhobi Forest Watchtower & Waterhole
topPlaces.description: Forest observation deck overlooking natural watering holes frequented by deer and wild boars.

image.alt: Dhobi Forest Watchtower & Waterhole - Temple 12 - Ruins of the ancient Nalanda University.

topPlaces.name: Falgu River Upper Catchment & Rapids
topPlaces.description: Picturesque rocky riverbed and natural stream cascades feeding the sacred Falgu basin.

image.alt: Falgu River Upper Catchment & Rapids - Ruins of the ancient Nalanda University

topPlaces.name: Koderma Border Ridge & Hill Trail
topPlaces.description: Rugged hill plateau offering panoramic views across the forested boundary of Bihar and Jharkhand.

image.alt: Koderma Border Ridge & Hill Trail - Brick masonry - Temple 13 - Ruins of Nalanda Mahavihara

topPlaces.name: Bodh Gaya Green Buffer Eco Trail
topPlaces.description: Protected forest green belt connecting the wildlife corridor with Bodh Gaya’s monastic zone.

image.alt: Bodh Gaya Green Buffer Eco Trail - Nalanda University Ruins

topPlaces.name: Mahuadanr Butterfly & Birding Meadow
topPlaces.description: Wildflower meadow hosting dozens of native butterfly species and migratory winter warblers.

image.alt: Mahuadanr Butterfly & Birding Meadow in Gautam Budha Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Barabar Foothills Forest Trail
topPlaces.description: Forested granite outcrops and trail leading towards ancient 3rd-century BCE Mauryan rock-cut caves.

image.alt: Barabar Foothills Forest Trail in Gautam Budha Wildlife Sanctuary, Bihar
